Coram : KRISHNA MURARI*, S. RAVINDRA BHAT
Motor Vehicle – Accident – Claim – Assessment of compensation – Permanent Disability Percentage – Appellant was travelling in a bus which was driven in a rash and negligent manner by the respondent – Bus met with an accident and – The MACT (Tribunal) by holding that it was the rash and negligent driving that caused the accident, awarded a compensation of 15,76,465/- – High Court modified and enhanced the compensation to 16,70,932/- – High Court assessed the appellant’s functional disability
Decision Date : 09-12-2022 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 9070/2022 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
